card.name: Springheart Nantuko

abilities.text: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you may pay {1}{G} if this permanent is attached to a creature you control. If you do, create a token that's a copy of that creature. If you didn't create a token this way, create a 1/1 green Insect creature token.

effects.prompt: Pay {1}{G} to copy the enchanted creature?
